id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying a request whop rejects as invalid

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability: P1.F1.H1 adds a non-retryable classification for Whop 400 Bad Request errors, preventing repeated scheduling of failed table syncs; P1.F2.H2 adds a parametrized test to verify this classification against transient errors.
review.reason: Adds a non-retryable error entry for Whop 400 Bad Request, with a user-facing message and a comment explaining that Whop returns code=bad_request for rejected table queries, distinguishing it from transient 429/5xx. P1.F1.H1. Adds an import of error_message_matches and a parametrized test checking that a 400 error is classified as non-retryable while 429 and 503 are not. P1.F2.H2.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the Whop integration being active and the distinction between transient and permanent errors being relevant to PostHog's warehouse ingestion workflow; no adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned. No adoption, incident, or benefit inferred. No tier assigned.
